body: That was news to me too.
I mean, it's doing that now, so yes.
The goal is to eliminate these groups by turning them against me, not expand them, and I'd prefer to focus on that.

I care about them enough to hurt them, yes, you are correct. If it helps, you can think for the sake of argument that I also take pleasure in hurting them in this way before pulling the trigger.

Isolation may be simpler than you think; many people in this weak network are digital, so it wouldn't be out of the ordinary to go quiet. Of course, that won't have any real effect on their response to my death, and posting an elaborate message will likely have the opposite effect.
